message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is a detailed breakdown of the website design for the **Trigger** app landing page:

### **1. Overall Layout & Background**
*   **Layout:** A modern, asymmetric two-column layout. The left side contains text content and call-to-action (CTA) elements, while the right side features a large product showcase (mobile phone mockups).
*   **Background:** A very light, soft mint green gradient background.
    *   **Color Code (approx):** `#E8F5E9` or `#F0FDF4` (Light Mint/Off-white).
    *   There are subtle, abstract organic blob shapes in a slightly darker mint green (`#C8E6C9`) positioned behind the phones to add depth without distraction.

---

### **2. Typography & Text Content**

**A. Header Section (Top Left)**
*   **Tagline:**
    *   **Text:** "READY TO CONNECT?"
    *   **Font Style:** Uppercase, sans-serif, bold/semi-bold.
    *   **Color:** Bright Green `#22C55E` (or similar vibrant lime-green).
    *   **Spacing:** Significant letter-spacing (tracking).
*   **Main Headline:**
    *   **Text Line 1:** "Download Trigger"
        *   **Color:** Very Dark Navy/Black `#0F172A`.
        *   **Weight:** Extra Bold / Black (800-900).
    *   **Text Line 2:** "on Google Play"
        *   **Color:** Vibrant Green `#16A34A` (slightly darker than tagline).
        *   **Weight:** Bold (700).
    *   **Size:** Large display size (approx 48px–64px).
*   **Sub-headline (Description):**
    *   **Text:** "Join a global 18+ community. Chat, call, stream and be part of something real. Real people. Real conversations. Real connections."
    *   **Color:** Medium-Dark Gray `#4B5563` or `#64748B`.
    *   **Style:** Regular weight, line-height approx 1.5 for readability.

**B. Feature Grid (4 Columns)**
Located below the sub-headline. Each feature has:
1.  **Icon:** Inside a light green circular background (`#DCFCE7` or `#D1FAE5`). Icons are in Green `#16A34A`.
2.  **Title:** Bold, Dark Navy `#1E293B`. Font size approx 14–16px.
3.  **Description:** Smaller, Gray `#64748B`. Approx 12–14px.

*   **Feature 1:**
    *   Icon: Lightning bolt ⚡
    *   Title: "Fast & Secure"
    *   Desc: "Smooth and reliable experience"
*   **Feature 2:**
    *   Icon: Shield with checkmark 🛡️
    *   Title: "100% Private"
    *   Desc: "Your safety matters"
*   **Feature 3:**
    *   Icon: Group of people (users) 👥
    *   Title: "Global Community"
    *   Desc: "Meet real people worldwide"
*   **Feature 4:**
    *   Icon: Download arrow (down) ⬇️
    *   Title: "Regular Updates"
    *   Desc: "New features and improvements"

**C. Right Side Decorative Text**
*   **Text:** "Same App Different Stories" (written vertically)
    *   **Style:** Handwritten script font, cursive, italicized.
    *   **Color:** Green `#15803D`.
    *   **Position:** Far right edge, rotated slightly.

---

### **3. Buttons & Call-to-Action (CTA)**

**Primary Button (Google Play Download):**
*   **Shape:** Rounded rectangle (border-radius approx 12px–16px).
*   **Background Color:** Solid Green `#16A34A` (or `#15803D`).
*   **Content:**
    *   Left: Google Play Triangle Logo (Multi-color: Blue `#4285F4`, Red `#EA4335`, Yellow `#FBBC05`, Green `#34A853`).
    *   Text: "Get it on" (small, white, above) + "Google Play" (larger, white, bold).
    *   Right: Arrow icon → (white).
*   **Hover State (implied):** Likely darkens to `#166534`.

**Secondary CTA (QR Code Section):**
*   **Layout:** To the right of the main button.
*   **Visual:** A black and white QR code square with rounded corners.
*   **Text beside QR:**
    *   **Header:** "Scan QR Code" (Bold, Dark Navy).
    *   **Subtext:** "to download Trigger app" (Gray).

---

### **4. Product Showcase (Mobile Phones)**

Two smartphones are displayed at an angle (isometric/3D perspective), overlapping slightly.

**Phone 1 (Left/Back): Splash Screen**
*   **Screen Background:** Solid vibrant Green `#16A34A`.
*   **Content Centered:**
    *   Large White Speech Bubble icon (two overlapping bubbles).
    *   **Logo Text:** "TRIGGER" (White, Bold, Uppercase, Large).
    *   **Tagline below logo:** "Live · Chat · Call" (White, smaller, spaced out).
    *   **Decorative Script:** "Real Conections Always" (White handwritten font, bottom half). Note: "Connections" appears misspelled as "Conections" in the design.

**Phone 2 (Right/Front): App Interface (Chat List)**
*   **Status Bar (Top):** Time "9:30", Signal, WiFi, Battery icons (Black/Dark Green on light bg).
*   **App Header (Dark Green `#064E3B` or `#022C22`):**
    *   Left: Green chat bubble icon + "TRIGGER" (White text).
    *   Right: Search icon (🔍), Notification bell (🔔).
*   **Navigation Tabs (White bg):**
    *   "Chats" (Active, Green text with green underline), "Calls", "Live", "People".
*   **Chat List Items (White background):** Each row contains:
    *   **Avatar:** Circular photo (various people).
    *   **Name:** Bold black text (e.g., Ananya, Riya, Sneha, Arjun, Meera, Team Trigger, Priya).
    *   **Message Preview:** Gray text, truncated (e.g., "Hey! are you online?", "Sent a photo").
    *   **Metadata (Right side):** Time stamp (Gray) + Unread badge (Green circle with white number '2' or '1').
    *   **Special Indicators:**
        *   Sneha: Mic icon (Voice message).
        *   Meera: Red video icon (Missed video call).
        *   Priya: Location pin icon (Shared location).
*   **Bottom Navigation Bar (White/Light Gray):**
    *   Icons: Chats (Green active), Calls, Plus (+) button inside green circle (Floating Action Button style), Live, Profile.

---

### **5. Spacing & Visual Hierarchy**

*   **Padding:** Generous whitespace around all elements (approx 40px–80px margins).
*   **Alignment:** Left-aligned text block creates a strong vertical axis. The phone images are right-aligned but overlap the center slightly to create visual tension/balance.
*   **Shadows:** Soft drop shadows under the mobile phones to lift them off the background (color: `rgba(0,0,0,0.1)`).
*   **Iconography Style:** Line icons (outlined) for features; Solid icons for UI elements within the phone mockup.

### **Summary of Key Hex Codes:**
| Element | Color | Hex Code (Approx) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Primary Brand Green** | Buttons, Headings | `#16A34A` |
| **Vibrant Accent Green** | Tagline | `#22C55E` |
| **Dark Navy** | Main Headline | `#0F172A` |
| **Body Text Gray** | Descriptions | `#64748B` |
| **Background** | Page BG | `#F0FDF4` |
| **App Header Dark** | Phone UI Top | `#064E3B` |
| **Icon Circle BG** | Feature icons | `#DCFCE7` |
